info.title: Ablaki node financial report
info.description: Code prepared, not tested or deployed. No new migration; current branch requires marker 21. Owner-only lifetime flows and filtered journal, no mutations.

get.summary: Owned node lifetime balances, flows, reconciliation and journal
get.description: world_read and actual ownership required. Does not need wallet/storage activation. A REPEATABLE READ snapshot keeps balances/totals/count/items coherent. Query uses only this node budget and treasury; world loss sink and descendant accounts are excluded. Internal transfers appear once. Foreign account IDs, foreign balances, user IDs and operation IDs are not returned. All totals are over the whole lifetime, even when the journal is filtered; sort is fixed descending ID. GET does not collect, repair balances, settle losses, create accounts or enqueue jobs.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed substring of purpose; filters journal before count and pagination.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: other selects kinds unknown to this report version.

200.description: One consistent snapshot; absent accounts return zeros. Mismatched ledger balances are explicit flags, not automatically corrected.

403.description: Actual owner required; manage is not an override

503.description: World read/schema unavailable or invalid account amounts/reserves

totals.description: Unaffected by q/kind/direction/page. treasury_received excludes transfers from this same budget/treasury; parent_received/payments_received/other_received partition that total. treasury_to_budget and budget_to_treasury are internal regardless of kind. Remaining inflow/outflow categories exclude internal transfers. Payments group: order_payment, crop_purchase, premises_purchase, garden_purchase, garden_expansion, equipment_expansion, building_repair. Budget grants appear as budget_other_in/out, not new revenue. Unknown kinds are included under other, not dropped.

matches.description: Exact equality of account amount and all ledger credits minus debits. Assumes provisioned zero opening balances. Does not verify all reservations or domain receipts.
